page.overview:
Who is Alexander Luthor, Jr.?

When Kord confronted Alex and Superboy-Prime, Alex tried to get Ted to join them in the hope of going ahead with their plan but Ted refused. Instead, Kord convinced Superboy-Prime to side with him over Alex.

Knowing that there was no point to get Superboy-Prime back on his side, Alex was forced to kill both the Earth-2 Superman and Lois Lane with a Kryptonite-powered gun that he designed to kill Superboy-Prime.

But Alex's plans end in vain when he himself is killed by Superboy-Prime who uses his eye-beams to incinerate Alex's body.
